question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which story did you enjoy most?
What is your favorite winter holiday?

nodes.text: In this story, we're taking you into the mind of Amanda! What's really going on inside her head?
Read on to find out!
It's winter break, and the cheerleaders are huddled together for warmth during practice...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We're like a can full of penguins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So cold...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: This is the worst! I can't feel my toes!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I could be at home sipping hot cocoa and making out with Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: At the same time?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I tried that once, but it's hard to kiss through all those marshmallows!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Amanda, it's freezing in here, and you're wearing a mini-skirt! How can you be so happy?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! I `am` happy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee! I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] happy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, girls...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How many times do I have to bring up the 'girls' thing, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev! Fine... Girls `and` Hector.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatev! Fine... Girls [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Hector.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, what about me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Forget it, Keith! Just be a girl!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We should give Keith a makeover!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: For a girl, he's got `way` too much chest hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: For a girl, he's got [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too much chest hair!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Enough! We're going to get this routine right for once!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As soon as we do, we can all go home...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I don't know about you, but I've got a million Christmas parties to crash!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why are parties getting into so many accidents?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda! Pay attention! After my toe-touch, you do a handspring!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay! Those make me `so` dizzy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay! Those make me [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] dizzy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you going to do after my toe-touch?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A handspring! Just like you said!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good... Then Keith, you bring Lyle out!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Got it...
The cheerleaders get into position! Jessica cues some music...
And the cheerleaders begin dancing! After a series of dance steps, Jessica does her toe-touch!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda! That's your cue!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... Right!
Amanda steps forward, holds her arms in the air, and says...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A is for Amanda!
The cheerleaders groan!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Did I say the wrong letter? Is it O for O-manda?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it isn't! How can you be so...?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Grr! Never mind! Let's just skip Amanda's part! Keith... Bring Lyle out!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh... I can't!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... I remember what I'm supposed to do!
Amanda tries to do a handspring, but when she lands, she hits her head!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whoa... I feel dizzy again!
No one notices...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Lyle rarely bites, Keith! Just suck it up and grab him!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: No, I mean...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Lyle's gone!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Lyle! Not again!
Amanda immediately drops her pom-poms and races toward the gym doors!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda! Where are you going? There's nothing over there!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have to go back! I have to save the world! I have to save Lyle!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Dude, your girlfriend is `really` into that lizard...
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, your girlfriend is [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] into that lizard...

nodes.text: Amanda runs to an oft-overlooked janitorial closet and opens the door.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I hope I'm not too late!
She steps inside...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: King Lyle? Falgar? Sir Sprinkles?
As Amanda walks deeper into the janitorial closet, a wind begins to blow...
Suddenly, she finds herself on a sunny mountain trail... A cat stands before her.

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Welcome back, Amanda. You'll forgive me for being curt, but the situation is dire indeed.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I came at once, Sir Sprinkles!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: I don't doubt your urgency... You've done more than your share for our world...

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: I'll never forget how you saved all kittenkind from disease by bringing us the Great Stone of Healing!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love kittens!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: I'm afraid we must call upon you once again.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What is it? What's happened to King Lyle?

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: As you well know, Jeasyxs the Destroyer was imprisoned in the Cave of Crystals and trapped under a landslide of a thousand boulders!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I remember that!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Knowledge of Jeasyxs has somehow trickled into your realm. He has grown stronger!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He didn't?!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: He did.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He didn't?!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: He did!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He didn't?!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Enough! He did!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: He escaped the Cave of Crystals and came to your world, obsessed as always with his brother...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Lyle?

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Yes, he captured Lyle and intends to kill him in the most horrible way...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eeep! Not the horrible Badgersaur!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Exactly... And if he feeds Lyle to the Badgersaur...
Sir Sprinkles hangs his head...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Then we won't be protected by Lyle anymore!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Jeasyxs will destroy everything that you hold dear!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector! My friends! Thirty percent off sales at `Jeaneology!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector! My friends! Thirty percent off sales at [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeaneology![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: All gone...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No way! What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: You must obtain the Great Glitter Sword...

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: The prophecy of Jeasyxs states that 'The wielder of the Glitter Sword will find their way to Jeaxsys's heart, ending his evil!'

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're so cute, Sir Sprinkles!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: With your little fact and your little tummy and your funny little ears...

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Did you hear me?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Where do I get the sword?

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: The sword is held in a tomb...

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: When Jeaxsys learned of the prophecy, he locked the sword in the tomb, broke the key, and scattered the pieces into four locations!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: The Fairy Village, the Cave of Crystals, Monkey Forest, and the Kingdom of the Horse-Dragons!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! How am I supposed to get all those pieces in time to save Lyle?
Sir Sprinkles rolls onto his back, exposing his belly.

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: You must call Falgar, the fastest creature in all the land, by rubbing my tummy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Kitty rub!
Amanda crouches down and rubs Sir Sprinkles's belly.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love calling Falgar! It's so fuzzy!
Sir Sprinkles's belly illuminates and casts a yellow beam of light high into the air!
Soon, a strange creature arrives! It has the body of a pony and the head of a bear!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Hello, Amanda! You called me?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Falgar!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Go, Amanda! Time is running out!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! It's like an algebra quiz!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: What is an algebra quiz?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's the worst, most awful thing in the world!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Knowing the things you have faced, Amanda, I can only surmise that an algebra quiz is...
A shudder runs through Falgar's massive haunches.

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Nay! I dare not think about it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's usually the best policy!

nodes.speaker: Sir Sprinkles
nodes.text: Enough about the great and terrible algebra quiz! You must go, Amanda, post-haste!
Amanda leaps onto the back of Falgar!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: To Fairy Village!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Growl!
In the hills of Fairy Village, Amanda combs through mud and sludge, looking for the first key piece.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ew!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Grrr`owl!` My fur coat is getting awfully messy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr[color=#e23b3b][i]owl![/i][/color] My fur coat is getting awfully messy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Keep looking, Falgar! The Fairy Queen said it was out here some...
Amanda's hand finds something metallic beneath the mud!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I found it!
At the Cave of Crystals...
Amanda does the Dance of the Dead before a huge skull-shaped altar!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is really fun! Dance with me, Falgar!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Uh... Bear-ponies don't dance!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Come on! Get down!
Falgar trudges out to Amanda, and begrudgingly dances with her. When the dance is done, the skull's mouth opens!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! The second piece of the key!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Now we're seventy-five percent of the way there!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Uh... Amanda? We've found two out of four pieces, so we're...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No time for talking, Falgar! Hyah!
In tropical Monkey Forest, Amanda meets with Monkey Princess Bonga!

nodes.speaker: Princess Bonga
nodes.text: You once saved my family from Gorilla-Hamsters, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I did?

nodes.speaker: Princess Bonga
nodes.text: It was in the middle of the most epic battle of all time! We fought valiantly together to protect the Tree of Life?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector and I once hooked up in a tree!

nodes.speaker: Princess Bonga
nodes.text: You... You linked your arms together and threw each other from branch to branch?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No, but we'll definitely try that!

nodes.speaker: Princess Bonga
nodes.text: Whatever! I am forever in your debt! Here is a piece of the key!
Princess Bonga hands Amanda the third piece!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Goodbye, Princess!
And finally, Amanda finds the last piece buried in the stable of a giant, ferocious Dragon-Horse!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There, there, Mr. Dragon-Horse! Who wants his fiery mane brushed?
The Dragon-Horse neighs, a burst of fire spraying from his nostrils at Falgar!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: `Yah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee! I think he likes you, Falgar!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Come on! Let's get the sword!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: You don't have to tell me twice!
Amanda and Falgar leave the Dragon-Horse behind...

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: I'm surprised... You didn't desire to ride the Dragon-Horse, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ride the Dragon-Horse? What do I look like... A `nerd?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ride the Dragon-Horse? What do I look like... A [color=#3b78e2][i]nerd?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Not long after, Amanda skips through a darkened tomb and freezes when she sees the Great Glitter Sword!
Its hilt is encrusted with diamonds, and its blade is a brilliant white!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeep! It's so pretty!
Amanda picks up the sword!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Come on, Falgar! We have to save Lyle!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Growl! Are you sure you're up for facing Jeasyxs? He's stronger than ever!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't know, Falgar...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know I'm not as smart as Ben... Or as popular as Jessica... Or as athletic as Sam...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But...
A breeze blows through the tomb...

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't remember what I was saying!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Let's go slay the destroyer! To Badgersaur Mountain! Hyah!
Amanda spurs Falgar on...
Finally, they reach the top of Badgersaur Mountain...

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: Amanda! I should have known you'd be here to foil my plans!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Where's Lyle?

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: My stupid brother?! He's about to be eaten by the Great Badgersaur!
Jeasyxs nods his great horned head across the plateau of Badgersaur Mountain...
Where the Badgersaur stomps closer and closer to a small, familiar lizard!

nodes.speaker: Badgersaur
nodes.text: Food!

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Mrrrp!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Lyle?! Oh no! We're too late!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: Indeed you are! But fear not, you simple red-haired girl!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: Once I rule your land, you shall be my servant!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: And I expect to have my belly rubbed `daily!` Hahaha!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I expect to have my belly rubbed [color=#e23b3b][i]daily![/i][/color] Hahaha!

nodes.text: Amanda breaks down into tears...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Lizard rubs are so prickly!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Growl! Amanda! The sword!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh yeah!
Amanda unsheathes the Great Glitter Sword!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: No! How did you unlock the tomb?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't know...
Amanda holds the Glitter Sword to Jeasyxs's neck!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I do know that if Lyle goes, then so do you!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: Foolish girl! You think I don't know my own enemy?

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: You think I haven't heard of the legend of Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: The girl who mends the paws of fearsome beasts? Who stops to come to the aid of even the most meaningless rodent? Who has `really` good taste in tube tops?
nodes.text_bbcode: The girl who mends the paws of fearsome beasts? Who stops to come to the aid of even the most meaningless rodent? Who has [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] good taste in tube tops?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She sounds amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: I'm talking about you!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! Hee! I sound amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: My point is that you can't slay me! You love animals too much!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: You're bluffing!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh am I?
Amanda raises her sword to strike Jeasyxs down...
But lets it fall to the snow!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `am` bluffing!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] bluffing!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: Your strength is your weakness!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... But... Lyle...

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: What about him?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He's your brother!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So?! So?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So, it's Christmas! And Christmas is the time to treasure family most!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: We don't have Christmas in this world!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! No Christmas?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Does that mean... No presents too?!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: What are `presents?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#e23b3b][i]presents?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh again!
Amanda picks the Great Glitter Sword up...
And hands it to Jeasyxs!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Amanda! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Here! Merry Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: What `are` you doing?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] you doing?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is the only thing that can destroy you, Jea... Jea... Lyle's brother.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It must worry you a lot...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So, in the spirit of Christmas, I'm giving it to you as a present... So you don't have to worry anymore!
Jeasyxs looks at the sword...
Then he looks across the mountaintop as the Badgersaur leans down to scoop Lyle up!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: Whoa, Carl! Whoa! Don't eat that lizard!
The Badgersaur stops, Lyle halfway into its mouth...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Frpppp!

nodes.speaker: Badgersaur
nodes.text: Food?

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: Not food!
Carl the Badgersaur reluctantly sets Lyle down and stomps away. Jeasyxs turns to Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: This is the nicest thing anyone's ever done for me...

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: In return, I shall spare Lyle...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!
Jeasyxs disappears in a cloud of smoke!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: The prophecy has been made true: 'The wielder of the Glitter Sword will find their way to Jeaxsys's heart, ending his evil!'
Amanda races over and picks Lyle up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: King Lyle! You're safe!

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Prr!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks, Falgar!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: You've saved us again, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I must get back! Tell Sir Sprinkles I'll miss him!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Of course! And we'll miss you!

nodes.speaker: Falgar
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I must be going home. My wife's making every bear-pony's favorite dish, hay-stuffed salmon!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Come on, Lyle... Let's go home too!
Amanda takes a step forward and raises her arm.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A is for Amanda!
As soon as Amanda says the words, a portal opens up beneath her, and she and Lyle jump through...
Amanda opens her eyes. Lyle is licking her face...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Prr!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Lyle!
Amanda rubs her head.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Stupid handspring!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Anyway, come on, Lyle! Let's get you back where you belong!
The cheerleaders are still in practice, huddled around Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Brr! Without Lyle, we'll have to come up with an entirely new routine!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That means we'll have to be in here freezing all day!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that means no party-crashing...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh! This is the worst Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No, it isn't!
Amanda comes running in through the doors, holding Lyle in her arms.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where'd you find him, Manda-Panda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He was on top of Badgersaur Mountain again!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Did I say something weird?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who cares? You got Lyle back!
The cheerleaders cheer!
Just then, Amanda sees a cat dart by one of the gym windows...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Squee! Belly rub!
Amanda breaks off from the group...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda, where are you going now?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I want to see if I can call a bear-pony!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Your girlfriend might be... Strange...
The guys watch through the window as Amanda gives the cat a belly rub.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: But she's `really` good with animals...
nodes.text_bbcode: But she's [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] good with animals...

nodes.text: Looks like Amanda saved the world... And simultaneously spared the cheerleaders a miserable day!
Hope you enjoyed the Chronicles of Amanda!
What does this last day of the year have in store for Paige? Read on to find out!
It's New Year's Eve, and a luxurious, gold-plated stretch limo drops three very happy Monarch Prep girls off for a night on the town!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoo! Partying on New Year's Eve is going to be the best ever!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So where are we going first?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The Diamond Room at Le Fantastique. I read about it in Teen Sophisticate.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Le Fantastique? You mean the freshest, most fashionable French Asian fusion restaurant in the entire city?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! And for New Year's, they're going to have indoor fireworks, an exclusive pre-fixe menu, and desserts made of diamonds and gold!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Plus, they have world-class dentists on hand, for when people cut their teeth eating diamonds and gold!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Let's go already!
At Le Fantastique, Penelope goes to the hostess stand while Paige and Prissy loiter in the crowded waiting area.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Gold trim, glass chandeliers, blue curtains, and marble floors? It reminds me of my third beach house... The one I don't even like.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't be so dour. I like it.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You only like it because everything matches your dress.
Prissy gestures to Paige's outfit. It's a light blue, silk dress studded with diamonds and crystals that glint in the light.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What can I say? I like matching.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh, where is Penelope?
Paige looks over and sees Penelope fighting her way back from the hostess stand.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I just talked to the maitre d', and he said you have to have a reservation in order to even think about getting a table tonight!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: And before you ask, they're booked through September 2016!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I was so looking forward to this! I don't want to go anywhere else!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then don't... Come on!
Paige walks over to the maitre d' and pushes her way to the front of the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Miss, there is a `line`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Miss, there is a [color=#e23b3b][i]line[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, I'm sure that's fine for normal people, but we're pretty special...

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I can only accept people who actually `have` reservations.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, but I can only accept people who actually [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] reservations.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: We cannot seat you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: We `cannot` seat you.
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]cannot[/i][/color] seat you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, that's not what you said. I heard you say that you thought I was hot and wanted my phone number.
Paige throws her hands up in the air and turns to Prissy and Penelope.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Can you believe what he said to me? He was hitting on me!

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: `No!` I didn't do anything of the sort!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color] I didn't do anything of the sort!

nodes.text: Paige catches Prissy's eye and winks.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You were totally trying to flirt with her! I heard it. You can't deny it!

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: But I didn't...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, you totally asked for her number. Ugh, that is so wrong!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe we should have a chat with Teen Sophisticate and tell them that Le Fantastique has an awful wait staff!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: We can see how secure your job is if the restaurant gets all this bad press off your actions.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But don't worry, I'd be happy to just take it as a passing compliment if my friends and I were seated right away...
The maitre d' looks around at the growing number of heads turning in their direction.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: `Ahem,` I believe a table just opened up. Right this way, ladies...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahem,[/i][/color] I believe a table just opened up. Right this way, ladies...

nodes.text: The maitre d' brings them to a very small table in the back.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What is this? This isn't a table. It hardly qualifies as a `tray.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is this? This isn't a table. It hardly qualifies as a [color=#3b78e2][i]tray.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: It is the only table we have available. The couple who was to sit here waited months to get on the waiting list!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, sir... We're not exactly the patient type.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Or the type to sit in the back!
Paige looks around the restaurant and spies a private room where an extravagantly decorated table sits.
Beneath a golden chandelier, the table faces large bay windows, giving its occupants a view of the glistening New Year's Ball.
Paige points to it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I want to sit at that table.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I'd like to accommodate you girls, but I can't move the couple sitting there! They're in the middle of dinner!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I'm sure you can convince them to move.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or I'm sure I can set up that interview with Teen Sophisticate?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Just give me one moment to clear off your table.
The maitre d' goes over to talk to the couple.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: What's the meaning of `this?` It's my wife's and my 50th wedding anniversary! We're waiting for our next course!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's the meaning of [color=#e23b3b][i]this?[/i][/color] It's my wife's and my 50th wedding anniversary! We're waiting for our next course!

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I'm sorry, sir, but we have mistakenly seated you... If you come back this way, the next available table is yours...
The maitre d' ushers the couple away as waiters hurriedly take the couple's dishes to clear the table. Paige, Prissy, and Penelope sit down.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So far, I'm not impressed with the clientele they cater to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tell me about it. Honestly, people are so lame. Waiting in line for this? Why not just pay?
A waiter comes around with the menus. After a few minutes, the girls are ready to order.

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: Good evening, ladies! What can I get for you tonight? I have a lovely pre-fixe menu...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Not for me, thanks. I actually have a few questions about the menu. See, I have a lot of food allergies.

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: If you can tell me what you would like to avoid eating, I can guide you through the menu better.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Well, for starters, I'm allergic to caraway...

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: I can assure you that none of the items on this menu contain that.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh great! What about cream?

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: I'm afraid many of our dishes do contain cream... But I can ask the chef for items that do without it.

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: What about our coq au vin?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It often has celery in it... And I'm also allergic to corn, cashews, and calamari... Anything with a 'c' really...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: So that excludes crepes, cassoulet, and cargolade...

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: I'll have to check with the kitchen to see what you can eat...

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: Maybe you should just start with the bread basket.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Well, that depends... Does it contain bread? Because I'm allergic to that too.
The server turns to Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: And for you?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I see you have vanilla bean cream-filled crepes with candied ginger gelato on the menu.

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: Dessert first, I see. I'd be happy to get that out for you...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I'm not done yet. I'd like the crepe crispy, not doughy, and I don't want the vanilla bean filling inside the crepe, but on the side.

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Also, I

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: I... I might be able to accommodate that...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh, and I

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: The entire crepe?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: `No.` Bring out the crepe, but `not crispy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No.[/i][/color] Bring out the crepe, but [color=#3b78e2][i]not crispy.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Got it?
The waiter nods as he hurries to write everything down. He turns to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't worry, I'm not picky or allergic to anything, but I have to say, I'm not in the mood for French fusion.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you have anything American? I really want a burger and fries...

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: This is Le Fantastique! We do not have the materials to make a proper burger...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is there another restaurant around here that can?

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: There is the Cowboy Burger across the street...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah! That sounds good to me!

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: You'd like to order a burger and fries from the Cowboy Burger?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought I just said that. And if you could whip up some homemade ketchup... I always like that.

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: Ma'am! I can't run across the street and order a burger for you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: My job is to bring you food and excellent service at `this` restaurant! Not to order food for you from a fast food chain that everyone has access to!
nodes.text_bbcode: My job is to bring you food and excellent service at [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] restaurant! Not to order food for you from a fast food chain that everyone has access to!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Your job is to serve `me,` and you suck at it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Your job is to serve [color=#3b78e2][i]me,[/i][/color] and you suck at it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're not going to get it for me, I'm going across the street to get it myself!

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And when I come back, your manager is going to hear about this! I'll get you fired!

nodes.speaker: Server
nodes.text: No, wait... I have a family, and this is one of my better jobs... I have a son...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, you'll have plenty of time to spend with him when you're unemployed!
Paige gets up and storms out of the restaurant.
Outside, Paige braves the cold weather and navigates the slushy streets to get to the crosswalk.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The nerve of that guy! I can't believe he wouldn't do this for me! And now I'm out here all by myself in this gross, wet snow!
At the crosswalk, the light turns red.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And on top of everything, this happens!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not waiting for this! Paige waits for no one!
Paige steps into the street and begins walking.
Suddenly, there's a loud honk!
Paige jumps back just in time as a large truck thunders by, spraying her with muddy, slushy snow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `My dress!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]My dress![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's completely soaked through with mud! It's all `ruined!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's completely soaked through with mud! It's all [color=#3b78e2][i]ruined![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige storms into Cowboy Burger.
She enters the restaurant, dripping mud and water onto the floor. Some people turn to stare.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you looking at?!
She strides up to the counter where a handsome guy wearing a nametag that says 'Lee' is busy filling orders. She clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Whoa, you look like you've been hit by a truck.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You know, there's a clean uniform in the back I can lend you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I wouldn't be caught dead wearing a Cowboy Burger uniform. I look awful in polyester!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Sure, whatever you want. But I'd rather be wearing something warm and dry. Especially in this weather.
The door opens and a cold draft blows through, chilling Paige to the bone.
And so, a couple minutes later...
Paige steps out of the bathroom wearing khaki pants and a khaki shirt with 'Cowboy Burger' on the front.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Nice.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is the hat really necessary?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: It does hide the patch of muddy slush in your hair...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Good point.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Besides, I think it's cute.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, if this is the employee uniform, why aren't you wearing one?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I'm management. My dad kind of owns the place.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You must be so proud.
Paige walks around in the uniform, testing its starchiness.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Eww... This is so gross. I preferred my muddy dress.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Sounds like you're feeling better.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'd be better if you got me a double burger. No mayo, no pickles, and extra lettuce.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And a side of small fries.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Actually, make that a medium. It's been a bad night.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I can tell. I got your order in. It'll be $5.74.
Paige reaches for her purse... And finds it gone!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My purse! It's not here!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Maybe you left it in the bathroom?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, it's back at the restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, this is the worst night ever! Everything's in that purse... My phone, my car keys, my wallet!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: So... You won't be paying in cash or credit?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have the money to pay for this... Just not here.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't believe me? Do you know who I am?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Someone who's running out on the bill...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, I'll prove it to you! Give me five minutes, and I'll come back and buy out this entire place!
Paige storms out of the Cowboy Burger....
And barges into Le Fantastique!
She starts to walk towards the dining area of the restaurant when the maitre d' stops her.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Ahem. Do you have a reservation?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't need one. I already have the table in that private room!

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Miss, you are mistaken. The girl who sits at that table is a sophisticated dresser...

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: She is `not` a drone fast food attendant wearing a cheap polyester uniform that smells of beef oil.
nodes.text_bbcode: She is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a drone fast food attendant wearing a cheap polyester uniform that smells of beef oil.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, `I'm` the one who usually insults people in the lower classes! I could have your job for this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one who usually insults people in the lower classes! I could have your job for this!

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I am the girl that came in earlier! You tried to hit on me! Remember?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I would do no such thing! Firstly because it's inappropriate... And secondly because I wouldn't be interested in someone so homely!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Homely? `Homely?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Homely? [color=#3b78e2][i]Homely?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to ask you to leave.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Aside from your appalling behavior, you are not appropriately dressed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am, aren't I?
Two men escort Paige out of the restaurant.
Paige walks wearily to the end of the street and sits on the curb, hugging her knees.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just got kicked out of a restaurant, I'm hungry, and I'm wearing polyester!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...This sucks!
People waiting for the chance to eat at Le Fantastique look down at her curiously. One older man hands her a dollar.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I do `not` need money!
nodes.text_bbcode: I do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] need money!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You sure?
Paige looks up. Lee is standing there, holding a Cowboy Burger bag.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I saw you from across the street, and I'm on my break. It looked like you needed a pick-me-up.
He hands Paige the bag. Inside is her burger.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I included large fries since you're having such a bad day.
Paige digs into the food.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They won't let me inside the restaurant, and I got kicked out for wearing this uniform.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Usually, I just drop my name and a couple bills, and it's no problem but... Without my purse...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is this what it's like not having money or fame? How do people live like this?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: People get by. And sometimes other people help and make it easier to do that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I did mean to pay you for the burger. It's just...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Your purse, I got it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: No, I mean, if you can't just walk in and get it, maybe there's another way...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe when Prissy and Penelope are done, they'll find me out here... But that might not be for another hour...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Or we could find a way to sneak you in!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?
Lee spots a small florist's booth just outside the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I have an idea...
Lee buys a bouquet of flowers and a cluster of balloons. He hands the flowers to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, uh, no thanks. I prefer roses.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Good thing they're not for you. This is our 'in'.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Hold them high so they cover the Cowboy Burger shirt, and then come with me.
They enter Le Fantastique. Lee walks in with authority and urgency. Paige follows him, hiding behind the bouquet.
Before they can get into the dining area, the maitre d' stops them.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Hold on. What's this? Do you have a reservation?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Don't need one, sir. I'm with Lee's Floral, and we're scheduled to make a delivery to Mrs. Crubblebutt.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: It's their anniversary dinner tonight, and Mr. Crubblebutt needs the flowers and balloons `five minutes ago.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's their anniversary dinner tonight, and Mr. Crubblebutt needs the flowers and balloons [color=#e23b3b][i]five minutes ago.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: I can take those off your hands...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Sorry, man. Can't. Lee's Floral is known for excellent service, and we don't trust others to do our jobs for us.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: It'll only take a few minutes, sir. In and out.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Make it quick then.
He steps aside, and Paige and Lee stream into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mr. and Mrs. Crubblebutt?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: It was the first thing that came to mind.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, there's my table! I can grab my purse and pay you back for the burger...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You know what? Forget about it. This was the most fun I've had all evening.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You can even have these.
He hands her the balloons.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So I guess this is where we part ways.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thank you. For being so nice to me. You didn't have to.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I couldn't leave you to fend for yourself. People were starting to give you loose change.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Keep track of your wallet next time, eh?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And maybe I'll see you at Cowboy Burger again sometime.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, I don't think I ever want to see Cowboy Burger again.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Maybe somewhere else then. It was nice meeting you.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Happy New Year.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Happy New Year.
Lee takes off while Paige comes to the table and sits down.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige! You're back! You were gone for a really long time. We tried calling you, but...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You left your bag here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh, you smell like hamburgers! It's awful!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And are you wearing `baggy khaki pants?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And are you wearing [color=#3b78e2][i]baggy khaki pants?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What happened to you?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Is this one of those 'journey of self-discovery' things? Because my aunt went on one of those, and she is `inolterable` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Is this one of those 'journey of self-discovery' things? Because my aunt went on one of those, and she is [color=#3b78e2][i]inolterable[/i][/color] now!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's been a long night, and I'm ready to go now... Are you done?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: We just got the bill. I decided not to tip the waiter. The plate had ducks on it. I mean, come on. Ducks?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But Prissy... He has a kid...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So?
Paige slaps a large bill into the billfold as tip and heads to the front. Prissy and Penelope flank her.
On their way out, Paige sees the elderly couple they moved earlier for dinner. She goes up to their table, bearing the bouquet and balloons.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Special delivery for your anniversary!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Thank you, miss! This is so touching!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Happy New Year!
The girls walk out into the street...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What's gotten into you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I learned a lot when I didn't have my wallet.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You were gone for an hour!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: An hour is long enough to put some things together. Like, sometimes it's worth it to be nice.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: People get by. And sometimes other people help and make it easier to do that.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I just hope you didn't lose all your senses... Like, please don't tell me you're wearing `that` to the club...
nodes.text_bbcode: I just hope you didn't lose all your senses... Like, please don't tell me you're wearing [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] to the club...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... Polyester's kind of growing on me...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yes! It is literally growing on you! Like a fungus!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And these khakis just make my legs look so boxy!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Boxy is bad! Who wants to be boxy?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm just joking. I have a change of clothes in the limo. Come on, let's go to a party!
Looks like Paige learned a thing or two right before the New Year! And she managed to meet a pretty nice guy in the process!
Hope you enjoyed Riches to Rags!
In this story, we're going to show you what Kay and Kel's big plans are for the day after Christmas!
They can't possibly get into that much trouble, right? Read on to find out!
It's the day after Christmas, and the mall is packed!
Eager shoppers and people looking to return gifts crowd into walkways and stores.
In the midst of all this chaos, Howard and $ZOE are looking after the twins and Kara!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never seen it so busy.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I love having all the people around!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And I love the mall!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I want to go to the toy store!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I want to go to the arcade!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I want to go to the candy store!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I want to go to that store that has all the swords in the window!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: First off, no one is going to the weapons store...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Way to help the economy, `Howard...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Way to help the economy, [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And second, settle down, you two. Mom and Dad don't want to see us home for at least two hours.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We have time to do everything you want.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...`After` $ZOE picks what she wants to do.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...[color=#e23b3b][i]After[/i][/color] $ZOE picks what she wants to do.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Awww...
Howard turns to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope you don't mind that our first date after Christmas is babysitting the twins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's no problem, Howard. I enjoy hanging out with them, and Baby Kara is just so cute!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: `Gurble burble!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Gurble burble![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where do you want to go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm in the mood for some frozen yogurt...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's a really good place I've been wanting to try. You can pick out your favorite toppings!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Coo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess Kara is excited too! Come on, twins.
The twins look at one another.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard, can we go to the toy store?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now? But we're already heading this way.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Kay and I don't want to talk or watch you and $ZOE make kissy faces, and the toy store's just right over there. You can see the entrance from here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess you two are old enough now to enter a store by yourselves.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you two need to behave, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you go straight there and straight back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even if you want to go to the arcade, you tell me first, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We promise!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay!
Kay and Kel run into the toy store.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And now for our biggest and bestest holiday prank yet!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You brought the stuff?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah.
From her sweater, Kay produces a decorated coffee can and a folded sign. She opens it and spreads it out.
The sign reads, 'Kay and Kel Kids' Foundation: Donate Today!'

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Ready to give ourselves a holiday boost?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! Let's stand over on this side of the store and look pitiful.
They position themselves just outside the toy store. Kel sets up the poster and holds up the can.
Kay pulls a bell from her pocket and rings it.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Want to help out kids this winter?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Contribute to the Kay and Kel Kids' Foundation!
Some passers-by stop to read their sign. Kay steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Excuse me, miss! Would you like to donate?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well, isn't that sweet? You two are volunteering for a charity?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! For the Kay and Kel Kids' Foundation! We collect money and use that money to buy toys and candy for sad kids like us!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You don't look very sad.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I spent an entire year working in a factory. Your donations could keep me in school where I can learn to read!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Uh-huh... I can spare a few coins, I suppose.
Shapiro sighs and puts a few pennies in their coffee can before walking off.
Kel looks into the can sadly...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Slim pickings this year.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's okay, we have more time! We'll get more! I promise...
Kay and Kel approach more people!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Help the needy? Keep us from working in the coal mines another year!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Then where will we get coal? No `thank` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then where will we get coal? No [color=#e23b3b][i]thank[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Donate money for a new house? Ever since the fire, life hasn't been the same!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I can't this time... Business just isn't that good...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You look like a well-to-do person. Want to help by giving our charity a huge donation?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You'll be helping tons of kids find warm clothes to wear in winter!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My dad already contributes thousands of dollars to charities across the world.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Besides, I don't carry around `pocket change.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, I don't carry around [color=#3b78e2][i]pocket change.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: After twenty minutes, Kay peers into their coffee can.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This isn't looking good, Kel. At this time last year, we pulled in at least a dollar or two more!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And we haven't gotten any toys at all!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I don't get it. We're doing what we've done every year since we figured out coins can be exchanged for goods and services!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Let's just keep at it...
They approach two teenagers walking down the pathway.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Want to make a kid really happy? Donate now!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You won't regret it...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah right!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aren't you kids supposed to be cuter?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, I only give to cute causes! And my baby sister's cuter than you two.
They walk off.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, that didn't work... What are we doing wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I got it! They practically told us! We're not cute enough anymore!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I'm still cute.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, I mean, `yeah`, but we're not babies, like we used to be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]yeah[/i][/color], but we're not babies, like we used to be!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: People love feeling sorry for babies!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But where are we going to...
They exchange knowing glances.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: `Baby Kara!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Baby Kara![/i][/color]

nodes.text: They skip to the frozen yogurt parlor.
Howard and $ZOE are talking at a table. Kara crawls around under their feet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It'll work itself out, $ZOE. You'll see.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just hard. It's not like people are mean to me, but they're definitely not as friendly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've tried telling everyone it wasn't my fault, but no one will listen.
Kay tugs at Howard's sleeve.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard, can we take Kara to the toy store? There's a rattle there I think she'll really like...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think that's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Please? We've been so good this year!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And we just want to love Baby Kara! We won't go anywhere we haven't gone before!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We promise!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, twins. But same rules apply. Straight there and back. Tell me before you go anywhere else.
Kay and Kel take Kara with them.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, this will work. We just need to put Kara in these old towels to make her look poor...
Once again, the twins try their scheme...
In front of the toy store...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Toys for the needy! Donate today! Help this poor needy child!
Kay thrusts Kara out to people in the walkway. All the mall customers passing by stop to see the baby.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Please, sir, do you have money or toys to spare for the Kay and Kel Kids' Foundation?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This baby could use your help! She's been raised by wolves for the past two months! Your donation could help us place her in a good home instead!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: What a beautiful little girl! Of course I'll give money to help!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thank you!
And at the arcade...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Please, ma'am, give a little today for the needy? For this baby?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Oh, she's so beautiful! But she looks so sad...

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Coo coo!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It's because she was almost sacrificed to an evil lava god! Donating to us will help us hide her from evil cultists!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Oh, in that case, let me toss in a few dollars just to be extra sure she's safe!
And at the candy store...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Oh, what a sweet darling baby you have there!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: She's more than just an innocent face, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This child is humanity's only hope against the machines...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But relocation programs are so expensive! Donating to our foundation can really help us save her!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I see! I'm sorry, but I don't have any bills on me.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We're not picky. We take all donations! Money, toys, and chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, in that case, take this chocolate bar with gold filigree. Put it to good use!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Score!
Soon, Kay and Kel collect a bunch of money, toys, and treats!
They put Kara down and begin sorting out their earnings.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This is the life! We can buy whatever we want! Candy!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Swords!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: A flame thrower!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: A dragon!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! A `real` dragon!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! A [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] dragon!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Should we share with Kara?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Do you think she'll notice if we don't?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Maybe we should ask...
Kay and Kel turn back to Kara...
And find her missing!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Where did she go?!
They look around the area and meet back where they started.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Did you find her?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No. And I'm guessing you didn't either! What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard is going to `kill` us when he finds out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard is going to [color=#3b78e2][i]kill[/i][/color] us when he finds out!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Or worse! He'll ship us off to Alaska!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I'll never see Mom or my friends or my blanket Binkie again!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Stop that! Howard will only get mad at us `if` he finds out.
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop that! Howard will only get mad at us [color=#3b78e2][i]if[/i][/color] he finds out.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You're right! Maybe he won't notice she's missing... Howard can't always tell us apart. He'll never know!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, but Howard can tell the difference between `two` sisters and `three` sisters! He'll figure it out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but Howard can tell the difference between [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] sisters and [color=#3b78e2][i]three[/i][/color] sisters! He'll figure it out!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We have to tell him...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But not yet! If we find Kara first, it won't be a problem!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay! From here on out, we search everywhere! In every aisle, under every bench, and in every duct!
They look in all the stores they've been to, starting with the candy store...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Here, Kara! Where are you?!
Tracing their footsteps back to the arcade...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Come out, come out wherever you are!
Looking in every single vent...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hello-o-o-o?!
And coming back at last to the toy store...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Did you find her?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No! We should never have taught her how to play 'Hide From The Police'!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're never going to find her! We lost our baby sister!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We'll never get to sing to her or teach her how to write her own name...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We'll never teach her how to trick Howard into giving her what she wants!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I wish we'd never taken her out!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It made my tummy hurt just thinking of her all alone!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: This is all our fault!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And now we have to tell Howard...
Kay and Kel walk shamefaced up to Howard and $ZOE in the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard... We have something to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We... We lost Kara.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It was an accident! We swear! Honest! And we looked for her everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's really her own fault. She should've gone straight out and straight back just like you said!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But I wouldn't punish her too much...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What you two did was really irresponsible.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Really? Anyone could have done it. Didn't you ever lose us in a mall while panhandling customers?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, `no.` I never let you out of my sight...
nodes.text_bbcode: As a matter of fact, [color=#e23b3b][i]no.[/i][/color] I never let you out of my sight...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So how did you lose her?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, uh... Forget about that! What should we do about Kara?
Howard holds baby Kara up and stares angrily at the twins.

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Ha-wa!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kara! You're safe!
They hug Kara.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Oh, we're so happy to see you!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We looked everywhere! I thought we'd lost you... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard, how did you find her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well...
Twenty minutes earlier...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So how's Jessica's New Year's party shaping up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay. She keeps asking me to do these small tasks that take up a lot of time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Get this, she wants me to cut the letters of her name out of sparkly paper for confetti. Do you know how tough cutting 'S's is?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My fingers hurt just thinking about it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay... Today, I just want to enjoy time with you and your sisters.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Speaking of which... Where are they? I get nervous when I don't have them directly in my line of sight.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope the twins aren't charging other kids to ride the bikes in the toy store again...
At that moment, Hector and Amanda come up, holding baby Kara!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, dogg, I think this is yours.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's a `baby!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a [color=#3b78e2][i]baby![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why do you guys have her?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She was crawling around by herself in front of a store.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I wanted to keep her, but Hector says we should probably give her back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... Please take her. `Now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Please take her. [color=#e23b3b][i]Now.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard takes baby Kara off Hector's hands.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, you two.
As Hector and Amanda walk off, Howard bounces baby Kara in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kara? Where are your sisters?

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Brb. Baa baaa.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They left you all alone?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brb baa baaa to them to!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Howard? You're talking baby talk.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh. Whoops. That happens more and more these days.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Kara shouldn't be by herself. I trusted them to take care of her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, we're just going to keep her here with us... And teach them a lesson.
Back in the present...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We had it under control! She was only out of our sight for a second!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And we are really really sorry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Enough of that... We're going home...
They leave the restaurant and head to the parking lot.
Kay and Kel take turns holding Kara.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I'm sorry we lost you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And after everything you'd done for us too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everything she'd done?
Just then, Officer Monte strides up to them.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You three! Over there! Stop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which three?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll let you guess.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Boy, are you the one in charge of these three perps?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Perps? Have they done something wrong, Officer?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Boy, just answer the question. Are you the moral compass that guides these girls, the light in a dark tunnel...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The nanny of these babies?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't say 'nanny'... But, yes. I am their nanny. I mean, uh, compass. Why?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: They are in very big trouble!
Monte glares at the twins and Kara.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I received complaints from some customers who realized they'd been donating to the non-existent nonprofit known as the `Kay and Kel Kids' Foundation.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I received complaints from some customers who realized they'd been donating to the non-existent nonprofit known as the [color=#e23b3b][i]Kay and Kel Kids' Foundation.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And the description I got describes two clones and a miniature human. Just like `those three.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the description I got describes two clones and a miniature human. Just like [color=#e23b3b][i]those three.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Officer Monte turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now these girls are too young to be slapped with what I like to call 'The Cage', or jail.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But they're just good enough to go to what I like to call 'Character Refinement School', or Boot Camp.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can't send them to Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then what do you have to say to vouch for this tricycle of crime?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Officer Monte, I'm sure this is all a misunderstanding. Look at them, they're just kids...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Kids? You're expecting me to let them off the hook because they're 'just kids'?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's all just innocent fun.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Running a money racket is not just 'innocent fun'.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'll tell you when I was a kid, I didn't have to wheel and deal to get my money.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I got all sorts of jobs, pulled myself up by the handlebars of my moustache, learned character.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But if you let this behavior continue... I'll tell you what these 'kids' will become. Troublemakers!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This is the time 'fools' turn into 'fooligans'... 'Hoods' turn into 'hoodlums'... 'Laws' turns into 'outlaws'...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I gave you the chance to talk me out of this, but now I'm more sure than ever! Boot Camp it is!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, Officer Monte, their methods may have been wrong, but their hearts were in the right place.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, we were just trying to raise money and toys for kids everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What about the candy?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, we ate that already.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it doesn't do those less fortunate any good to eat sweets, does it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're really sorry about tricking people...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Aren't they?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aren't they?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Very sorry!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll make sure they own up for what they've done. But can you give them a break? It's Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's December 26, boy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Close enough?
Officer Monte deliberates for a moment, stroking his moustache thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: All right. I'll let them off the hook this time, but the next time these offenders offend, they're going straight to Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And you are too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
Monte turns and walks away.
Howard glares angrily at the twins.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You started the 'Kay and Kel Kids' Foundation'? That's the fake name you came up with?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's not fake!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where do all the toys for this charitable foundation go?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, to us, of course! `We're` the kids!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, to us, of course! [color=#3b78e2][i]We're[/i][/color] the kids!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. And why was Kara dressed in rags?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: People give more to the cute and sad!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mom and Dad are so going to ground you for this!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Please don't tell them, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Please! Please! Please!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're really sorry. We definitely learned our lesson!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You promise you won't do anything this stupid again?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I promise.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Promise.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. Fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But only because it's Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay! Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't thank me just yet. You two owe me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Big time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Big time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Uh-oh...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What do you want us to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, first things first. You're going to donate all the money you've made to an `actual` charity.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, first things first. You're going to donate all the money you've made to an [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] charity.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then you're going to find every person you asked for donations and apologize.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No 'buts'!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No 'Howards'!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Baa...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't you start. Come along, you three.
At the Helper Hands Children Center, Kay and Kel bring their donations to the director in charge of the orphanage.

nodes.speaker: Director
nodes.text: You're donating all this money? How ever did you raise so much?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We just asked people really nicely.

nodes.speaker: Director
nodes.text: You have no idea what this means to us.

nodes.speaker: Director
nodes.text: We always have trouble raising money, and the fact that you've brought us so much means we'll be able to provide our young people with more blankets, food, and books than ever!

nodes.speaker: Director
nodes.text: Thank you very much!
As they walk out of the center, Howard turns to the twins.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: They don't even get good gifts for Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I wouldn't want just socks.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It makes me feel sad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I hope you learned something about being nice to people... Because you still need to apologize to everyone whose money you took.
And for the next twenty minutes, the twins make amends...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I'm sorry, ma'am, for pretending to take your money for my own toys.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I'm sorry, sir, for using my sister's bright colors and cute face to empty your wallet.

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Baa ba. Brrrg.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe you scammed so many people.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're industrious!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I have to say... Even if you two are good at getting into trouble...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two are really brilliant...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. I think we've all had too much excitement today. We're going home.
Howard scoops Kara up in one arm and holds $ZOE's hand in another.
He walks forward, towards the mall exit.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two coming?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Right behind you!
As they walk out, Kay and Kel drag behind...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: What are you thinking? You have that look in your eye.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So I have an idea for next year...
Looks like even Howard can't stop the twins from getting into more mischief... But for today, they're okay!
Hope you enjoyed Kay and Kel's Christmas Crisis!
That just leaves The Chronicles of Amanda!
We hope you enjoyed the stories!
Wishing you happy holidays and an even happier new year!
